subject: Training window availability — final tie-breaker
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@zephyrtech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Training availability and quick prework question

Hi Ben / Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Roman and I talked offline and we're ready to lock a 90-minute enablement to walk our infra and app teams through the Console + API flow. We have two constraints: our SRE leads are only available in PST mornings, and our product folks prefer late afternoons.

Proposed windows (all PST):
- Option A: Tue 10 Aug 09:30 – 11:00 (hands-on API lab)
- Option B: Wed 11 Aug 16:00 – 17:30 (console walk + Q&A)
- Option C: Thu 12 Aug 11:00 – 12:30 (mixed)

Can you confirm which you can staff? Also — any required prework for our engineers? We can distribute a short checklist if you send it.

Attachments: None in this message

Thanks,
Sara
Product Ops | ZephyrTech
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@zephyrtech.com>, Roman Li <roman.li@zephyrtech.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Training availability and quick prework question

Sara — great, thanks. We can staff any of those windows but want to be deliberate about agenda so the right specialists join. Quick notes: 
- Option A is best for API deep-dive (we'll have an infra enablement engineer).
- Option B is friendliest for executive/product stakeholders (console lead + product solutions).
- Option C is fine as a hybrid.

Attached is our prework checklist and a short runbook (ZEP_prework-checklist.pdf, redwood-session-runbook.xlsx). The checklist calls out required API keys, service accounts, and a small example repo we ask attendees to clone (5–10 min prep).

If you want to fast-resolve, we suggest using a tie-breaker rule: if both SRE and product prefer different times, we prioritize the SRE window for the first session and schedule a follow-up 60-minute product-focused review the following week. That keeps the critical path moving.

Would you like me to send a calendar poll with the three options plus the fallback rule?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Roman Li <roman.li@zephyrtech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@zephyrtech.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Training availability and quick prework question

Thanks Ben — the tie-breaker approach makes sense to keep momentum. A couple of clarifying points:
- If we pick Option A (Tue 10 Aug 09:30), can you include a 15-minute block at the end for our SREs to validate token rotation and KMS integration? We want to validate the flow against our security checklist.
- For the follow-up product review, mid-next-week is ideal (Wed/Thu).

Yes please send the calendar poll; we'll respond within the day.

Roman
Lead SRE | ZephyrTech

Adding a couple of operational details from our side: 
- We'll include a 15-minute security validation slot at the end of the API deep-dive (Option A) to walk KMS rotation and token expiry patterns.
- For Option B, we'll limit the live demo to 30 minutes and leave 45 minutes for Q&A and migration planning.
- If you choose Option C we recommend booking 2 hours to avoid rushing — we can compress, but it's tight.

Ben — happy to own the follow-up product-focused 60-minute run if we go with the tie-breaker. I can also send the calendar poll with an explicit checkbox for accepting the tie-breaker fallback.

Camila
Enablement Lead | Redwood Inference

Perfect — I'll send a Doodle-style calendar poll with the three options and an explicit checkbox reading: \"I accept Redwood's tie-breaker: prioritize SRE availability for the initial session; schedule a 60-minute product follow-up next week if needed.\" We'll mark Option A as the recommended selection for technical correctness.

Action items:
- Ben: send poll + include the prework attachments and the short repo link (coming in the poll invite).
- Camila: you'll lead the product follow-up if tie-breaker is accepted.
- Sara / Roman: pick preferences in the poll; if SREs choose Option A we'll lock that and send calendar invites to all.

I'll include the attachments in the poll invite and drop a permissions link to the prework doc (Google Doc) — see link in the metadata.

Thanks all — talk soon.

—Ben
